doc: A built waterfront building: its mesh and bones (boats rock, nets sway, the crane's jib turns), its lot's cells (and which are water), its box, and collision.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height, metres (conformance).

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Conformance radius, metres.

fields.name: fire_points
fields.doc: Where fires burn, metres: hearths, forges, torches, braziers (lit), and points over its roof and walls that burn when it does.

fields.name: fire_configs
fields.doc: Each fire point's fire config (fire_config's id).

fields.name: fire_lit
fields.doc: Each fire point: 1 always lit (a hearth, a torch), 0 only while the building burns, 2 its smoke only (a chimney or a smoke hole: the hearth's smoke without its flames).

fields.name: footprint
fields.doc: Which lot it stands on.

fields.name: footprint_cells
fields.doc: The round footprint that holds it, for plotters that know only those.

fields.name: footprint_radius
fields.doc: The radius its round footprint must hold, metres.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: The cells it stands on, as q, r pairs (axial, pointy-top, 1 m cells), relative to the cell under the origin; +z is the water.

fields.name: wet
fields.doc: Which of its cells are water, as q, r pairs: a planner places it where these are water and the rest land.

fields.name: lot_min
fields.doc: The lot's box, its low corner, metres.

fields.name: lot_max
fields.doc: The lot's box, its high corner, metres.

fields.name: bones
fields.doc: The moving parts, animated by house_animate.

fields.name: positions
fields.doc: Vertex positions.

fields.name: normals
fields.doc: Vertex normals.

fields.name: indices
fields.doc: Triangles.

fields.name: bone_a
fields.doc: Skinning: first bone.

fields.name: bone_b
fields.doc: Skinning: second bone.

fields.name: bone_w
fields.doc: Skinning: the second bone's weight.

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: Packed RGBA per vertex.

fields.name: collision
fields.doc: What collides: buildings, decks, the crane.
